captions.detailed: A 3D model of a telephoto zoom lens featuring a main cylindrical barrel in a light gray finish, contrasted with a flared black lens hood at the front and a black mounting ring at the rear. It includes two distinct, ribbed black rings for zoom and focus adjustment along the upper half, and a black tripod collar with an integrated mounting foot clamped around its midsection. The zoom ring, focus ring, and tripod collar are designed to rotate continuously around the main optical axis of the lens.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a telephoto zoom lens. The model should feature a light gray main barrel, a flared black lens hood, ribbed black zoom and focus rings, and a black tripod collar with a mounting foot. Ensure that the zoom ring, focus ring, and tripod collar are articulated to rotate continuously about the main central axis.
captions.factory: Construct the main lens barrel using stacked cylinders of varying diameters and heights, combined with a hollowed-out cone for the lens hood. Model the zoom and focus rings as cylinders with repeating external ridges or grooves, placing them concentrically on the upper barrel. Create the tripod collar by combining a cylindrical band with a rectangular block and plate for the mounting foot. Define continuous rotational joints (articulations) along the Z-axis for the zoom ring, focus ring, and tripod collar relative to the main barrel.
